queries: 2013 IBM Watson DeepQA question answering documents

sources_considered.why: Original agent paper documents browser actions and end-to-end evaluation before the post.
Verifies the January 2024 release and its original reported success rate.
Dated technical account by researchers, including an IBM Watson researcher, describing answers derived from textual evidence.

evidence_items.explanation: WebVoyager observes websites, chooses actions and executes them through a browser, with an evaluation reporting 55.7% task success in this original version. Those interactive capabilities exceed answering questions from a supplied document, even though reliability was incomplete.

evidence_items.publisher: Association for Logic Programming; Adam Lally and Paul Fodor
evidence_items.locator: Opening explanation of question answering, following the abstract
evidence_items.explanation: The authors describe Watson's February 2011 system deriving answers using unstructured text and matching evidence from passages. This establishes the document-question-answering capability more than a decade before the post, without establishing equivalence to modern agent architectures.

unresolved_gaps: The post does not specify which marketed products belong to the group it describes.
The historical evidence establishes the age of a capability, not identity between old and new implementations.
